title: World Bank Commodity Price Data (The Pink Sheet), monthly prices

details.sheetSubtitle: monthly prices in nominal US dollars, 1960 to present

updateFrequency.statedAs: Commodity prices are updated in the second business day of the month.

aggregationBasis.note: Column heading used for monthly figures in the November 2026 Pink Sheet.

attribution: Source: World Bank, Commodity Price Data (The Pink Sheet), monthly prices, updated November 3, 2026. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
changesMade: SMPT extracted aluminum, copper, nickel, tin, zinc, lead and platinum from the November 3, 2026 Monthly Prices workbook for January 2005 to October 2026. Periods are normalized from YYYYMmm to YYYY-MM; published values are otherwise preserved. Platinum's June 2025 quotation change is marked explicitly. Percentage changes, indexed values and rankings are SMPT calculations.
thirdPartyNote: The World Bank lists Bloomberg, Platts Metals Week, Thomson Reuters Datastream and others as sources for these series. SMPT republishes only the World Bank's monthly figures, not the underlying daily exchange or vendor data.
